Netflix Film Chief Dan Lin Exits Amid Layoffs and Leadership Shakeup

Netflix has parted ways with its film chief, Dan Lin, as part of a significant leadership shakeup that also involves layoffs. The company has laid off approximately 1,000 employees. Lin's departure comes as Netflix restructures its film division.
